title: Euclid × SPT-3G 6×2pt
author: Cail Daley
description: The SPT × Euclid 6×2pt key-project paper for SPT-3G: the overlap, the MoU project and timeline, the KP2-3 pipeline and its mock covariance plans, the blinded TR1 data vector and first posteriors, where SPT-3G is tighter than ACT DR6, DR2, and how to take part through Euclid external-collaborator status.

sections.title: Opening
sections.outline: The SPT × Euclid 6×2pt paper, for SPT-3G.

sections.title: SPT × Euclid
sections.outline: The overlap with Euclid, the Euclid–SPT MoU project, the DR1 timeline, the CMBX key projects, the KP2-3 papers and the pipeline they share.

sections.title: Simulations and covariance
sections.outline: The FLASK mock covariance, not yet in the pipeline; its ACT and Planck-like matrices; two ways to put SPT-3G in it.

sections.title: TR1 × SPT-3G
sections.outline: Pipeline validation on GLASS mocks, the blinded TR1 data vector, the first blinded posteriors, where SPT-3G is tighter than ACT DR6, and Euclid DR2's overlap with SPT-3G.

sections.title: Taking part
sections.outline: The open questions, and Euclid external-collaborator status.

sections.title: Backup
sections.outline: The blinding rehearsal on a mock, the data products needed from SPT, the systematics-template crosses, and the FLASK mean spectra.
